tools.name: SAP Developers Search MCP
tools.what: Semantic search over SAP developer tutorials and missions.
tools.note: Anonymous, best-effort. Used by the Knowledge lookup in this edition.

tools.name: SAP Developers Knowledge Graph MCP
tools.note: Anonymous, best-effort. Used by the Knowledge lookup in this edition.

tools.name: SAP Developers public GraphQL
tools.note: Used by the private edition for discovery snapshots; not called from here.

tools.name: CAP MCP adapter (@cap-js/mcp)
tools.what: Exposes a CAP service to agents (describe, query).
tools.note: Needs Node.js and a CAP project on your machine. Demonstrated in project test runs (private edition).

tools.name: UI5 MCP server (@ui5/mcp-server)
tools.what: UI5 guidelines, API reference and manifest validation for agents.

tools.name: Fiori MCP server (@sap-ux/fiori-mcp-server)
tools.what: Fiori app generation and modification tools for agents.
tools.note: Includes write tools and, in the project's review, a tool that downloads a model on first use; review before use.

tools.name: ADT MCP server
tools.what: Agent access to ABAP Development Tools workflows.
tools.note: Needs an ABAP system (for example a trial) and an authenticated session. Never available publicly.

tools.name: SAP Developer CLI
tools.note: Installed from source; its init command can change configuration. Not verified here.

tools.name: SAP AI skills library
tools.what: Reusable skills for AI coding assistants.
tools.note: No verified, locatable artifact was found by the project.

tools.name: SAP Business Accelerator Hub APIs
tools.note: Registration and an API key are needed for sandbox calls.

tools.name: SAP Cloud SDK for AI
tools.what: Client SDK for SAP AI Core and Generative AI Hub.
tools.note: The SDK package is open source (Apache-2.0); the service it calls needs an AI Core entitlement.

tools.name: SAP AI Core / Generative AI Hub
tools.what: Managed AI platform on SAP BTP.
tools.note: Entitlement-gated and chargeable. Not called from this edition.

tools.name: SAP Joule / Joule Studio
tools.what: SAP's AI copilot and agent tooling.
tools.note: No public programmatic interface was found by this project; nothing is simulated here.
